logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. ACTIVE NODES: 64

panels.composition: The garage's beige monitor filling the page, its screen gray with the banner in phosphor-green blocks and the title legible across it, a cursor blinking after the last letter; on the desk before it the four stick figures' shadows thrown long by the screen's light, the figures themselves out of frame.
